passages.note: Third reading vote where Diaz voted Y on HB2853.
Diaz listed as a co-sponsor of HB2853 on the bill status page.

passages.provision_quote: Notwithstanding section 15-2401, beginning in the 2022-2023 school year, in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires, "qualified student" includes a resident of this state who both: 1. Is eligible to enroll in a public school in this state in any of the following: ( a ) A preschool program for children with disabilities. ( b ) A kindergarten program. ( c ) Any of grades one through twelve. 2. Does not otherwise qualify for an Arizona empowerment scholarship account pursuant to this chapter.
passages.note: Added section 15-2401.01 extends ESA eligibility to any student eligible to enroll in Arizona public school.

rows.reasoning: Diaz co-sponsored and voted Y on HB2853 (2022), a single-subject empowerment scholarship accounts bill signed into law; its new section 15-2401.01 extends ESA eligibility to any resident 'eligible to enroll in a public school,' matching rung 5, 'Providing universal vouchers so that education funding follows the student to any school... chosen by the family.'
